summary: Initializes a network listener object: runs the virtual init callback (vtable+72), resumes the object's thread, binds the UDP socket at this+0x93C to the base port this+0x910 and the TCP socket at this+0x938 to base port + 50, stores the incoming IP string via sub_587DD0 and configures the byte flags at this+0x967..this+0x96B, then on success starts a TCP listen with a 0x7FFFFFFF backlog and dispatches the post-listen virtual callback (vtable+144) with a locally built value before returning 0; returns 6 when either bind fails.

local_names.v4: success flag, cleared to 0 when either socket bind fails
local_names.v5: UDP socket handle read from this+0x93C
local_names.v7: vtable pointer read from this+0x0 for the post-listen dispatch
local_names.v9: zero-initialized out-parameter for the post-listen virtual callback, then written by MutexProtectedFieldWrite

operations.description: Dispatches the virtual init callback at vtable+72 (obj+0x48) with this as the instance.
Calls ThreadResumeWithMutexWait(this) to resume the object's thread under its mutex.
Initializes locals: v4 = 1 (success), v10 = 0, v11 = 0, and reads v5 (socket handle) from this+0x93C and v6 (base port WORD) from this+0x910.
Guard on the two binds: if SocketBindPortScan(v5, v6) < 0 or SocketBindPortScan(TCP handle at this+0x938, base port + 50) < 0 then v4 = 0.
Calls sub_587DD0(this + byte offset 2376, a2, 0x1F) to copy the incoming IP string a2 into the config buffer bounded to 0x1F bytes.
Configures the byte flags: this+0x967 = 0, this+0x968 = 1, this+0x96B = a3, this+0x96A = 1.
When v4 is zero (a bind failed) the routine returns error code 6 before any listen starts.
Calls the imported listen() with the TCP socket handle at this+0x938 and backlog 0x7FFFFFFF.
Calls ThreadSafeWriteWithMutex(this, 4) to record listener state 4 under the object's mutex.
Dispatches the post-listen virtual callback at vtable+144 (obj+0x90) with arguments (this, &v9, 2, 1) where v9 starts at 0.
Calls MutexProtectedFieldWrite(this, v9) to publish the value produced by the post-listen callback.

unresolved: Global 0x0059CA8B (SEH_5804A0) registers a structured exception handler for this routine but the handler's role and the failure it guards are not evidenced in the raw text.
Meaning of the vtable+144 call arguments (2, 1) and of the value stored via MutexProtectedFieldWrite is not established.
The buffer at this + byte offset 2376 is written by sub_587DD0 but has no named field evidence; its size/role beyond the 0x1F copy bound is unknown.
Error code 6's meaning to the caller and the semantic of ThreadSafeWriteWithMutex constant 4 are not evidenced.
